description: Exact TGeoRotation matrices for T1/T2 and reference Sci_stack volumes

T1_trigger_log_100.proof_of_orientation: Local z-axis after Ry(θ) is (sinθ, 0, cosθ). For θ=71.5°, z=(0.948324, 0, 0.317305) = arm unit vector. Dot(z_local, arm_vector) ≈ 1, confirming thin-axis faces target.

T2_trigger_log_101.proof_of_orientation: Local z-axis after Ry(-38°) is (sin(-38°), 0, cos(-38°)) = (-0.615661, 0, 0.788011) = arm unit vector. Dot(z_local, arm_vector) ≈ 1, confirming thin-axis faces target.

grazing_incidence_defect_analysis.description: What would happen if T1/T2 were NOT rotated
grazing_incidence_defect_analysis.consequence: Hit rate would be inflated by ~3.2× for T1, edge entry would be visible in local Position
grazing_incidence_defect_analysis.fix: TGeoRotation::RotateY(±arm_angle) in TGeoCombiTrans aligns thin-axis with arm unit vector
grazing_incidence_defect_analysis.verification: 10k output shows normal-incidence face entry (z=+0.50 cm), NOT edge entry. Rotation is live in G4 transport.

verification.method: ROOT macro dump of node translation + rotation matrix from both baseline and T1T2 exports
verification.independent_review: Team-lead verified T1 Ry(+71.5°) ≡ Sci_stack2_2, T2 Ry(-38°) ≡ Sci_stack1_1 (5 dp)
verification.status: CONFIRMED - rotation defect fixed, matrices identical to reference Sci_stacks
